turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. Who decided to enter that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." A zero went into the gradebook and nobody called me, and that is a decision, not a misunderstanding. I'm writing that down, Hale, and I'm waiting for you to tell me who made it.
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, which is on the record, so we don't need to agree on anything. Answer the question I've asked you twice.
